name: English
about: Blocky's English text, the source every other language falls back to. To add a language, copy this file into this folder as <code>.json, set locale and name, and translate the strings. Keep placeholders like {0} and {1}; they may move within a sentence.

strings.status.pick_object: Click an object in the game to code it
strings.mode.free.tooltip: The Scratch table: blocks go anywhere, and you can spread out, pan and zoom
strings.mode.simple.tooltip: One numbered column: every block joins the script, and the table only scrolls
strings.table.redo.tooltip: Put back what Undo took away (Ctrl+Y)
strings.tips.free.line.1: Drag a block out of the palette onto the table. Bring two blocks close and the edge they will join glows - let go to snap them together.
strings.tips.free.line.2: Click a block to pick it. Shift+click, or drag a box over empty table, to pick several and move them as one.
strings.tips.free.line.3: Delete or Backspace throws away what's picked, and so does dropping it back on the palette. Ctrl+Z undoes the last change, and Ctrl+Y (or the Redo button) puts it back.
strings.tips.free.line.4: Click an empty ⬡ hole to choose a condition, or drag one into it.
strings.tips.free.line.5: Right-drag (or middle-drag) empty table to move around it, scroll to zoom, or use + - = in the corner.
strings.tips.free.line.6: Step ▶ runs one block of every script - including scripts that wait for a key press, a bump or a look, which can't happen while everything is frozen.
strings.tips.simple.chip.2: Click a line to pick it
strings.tips.simple.chip.3: Drop on a line: above, replace, below
strings.tips.simple.line.1: Every block belongs to the script. Drop one anywhere and it joins the end of the script it landed nearest — bring it close to another block first and the edge glows, to put it exactly where you want it.
strings.tips.simple.line.2: There is one column, numbered like the lines of a program. Each line is a band across the table: click anywhere on it, not just on the block, to pick that block. Nothing can be left lying loose, and nothing can be hidden away off to one side.
strings.tips.simple.line.3: Drop a block onto a line and where on the line you let go decides what happens: near the top it goes in above, near the bottom it goes in below, and in the middle it takes that block's place. The bar — or the outline, for a replace — shows which before you let go.
strings.tips.simple.line.4: Delete or Backspace throws away the block you picked, and so does dropping it back on the palette. Ctrl+Z undoes the last change, and Ctrl+Y (or the Redo button) puts it back.
strings.tips.simple.line.5: Click an empty ⬡ hole to choose a condition. A condition dropped anywhere else goes back where it came from — a hole is the only place one fits.
strings.tips.simple.line.6: Drag empty space, or scroll, to move up and down the script. Switch to Free at the top for a table you can spread out on.
strings.tips.simple.line.7: Step ▶ runs one block of every script — including scripts that wait for a key press, a bump or a look, which can't happen while everything is frozen.
strings.advice.more: …and {0} more — look for the ! and ? badges on the blocks.
strings.advice.event_missing: This event block doesn't exist any more, so this script won't run.
strings.advice.empty_script: Nothing is under “{0}” yet, so nothing happens. Snap blocks under it.
strings.advice.loose_condition: “{0}” is a condition. It goes in a ⬡ hole in a block.
strings.advice.loose_condition.example: “{0}” is a condition. It goes in a ⬡ hole, like the one in “{1}”.
strings.advice.loose_blocks: These blocks have no event on top, so they never run. Snap them under an event block.
strings.advice.loose_blocks.go: These blocks have no event on top, so they never run. Snap them under “{0}”.
strings.advice.block_missing: This block doesn't exist any more, so this script won't run. Delete it.
strings.advice.empty_branch: “{0}” has nothing inside it yet. Put blocks in its gap.
strings.advice.missing_value: “{0}” is missing its “{1}” value, so this script won't run.
strings.advice.out_of_range: “{0}” in “{1}” must be from {2} to {3}, so this script won't run.
strings.advice.bad_choice: “{0}” isn't one of the choices for “{1}” in “{2}”, so this script won't run.
strings.advice.empty_hole: The ⬡ hole in “{0}” is empty, and an empty hole counts as “{1}”. Drag a condition into it.
strings.advice.condition_missing: The condition in this ⬡ hole doesn't exist any more, so this script won't run.
